results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: CPOV & Fleet Manager | Al- Futtaim Automotive | Honda & Trading Enterprises
results.location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: Job Requisition ID: 182051 About Al-Futtaim Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations. Overview Of The Role: The CPOV & Fleet Manager is responsible for overseeing Trading Enterprises' Pre Owned & Fleet operations across the UAE, executing strategic sales initiatives across corporate, SME, and dealer channels. This role requires a comprehensive management approach to ensure synergy among stakeholders and meet growth budgets. Managing a team of nine direct reports, the manager is tasked with expanding the business's market footprint while maintaining high standards of customer service and satisfaction. This role directly impacts the financial health of the organization by optimizing fleet sales, pricing strategy, stock management, and customer relations. What You Will Do: General Develop and roll out CPOV commercial programs for all brands, ensuring consistency and sharing of best practices. Roll out and maintain CPOV presentation standards, including digital visibility and brand standards, ensuring consistency across all brands. Set sales targets and drive KPI achievement for teams, encouraging evaluations and refurbishments while liaising with Dealer Principals for performance management. Manage stock, including reconditioning costs, stock mix, trade-in penetration, and ageing stock, and provide monthly reports on performance. Conduct regular site visits to coach sales executives, develop action plans for improvement, and ensure completion of all required training. Compile reports to provide transparency on business health, offering analysis and recommendations to the General Manager. Collaborate with Dealer Principals, Automall, and Aftersales to ensure effective use of matrix reports in sales, buying, and estimation. Coordinate and manage buy-back returns, including negotiations, inspection processes, and residual values. Engage with Centres of Excellence to share information, report findings, and roll out best practices and initiatives. Ensure customer service and satisfaction through adherence to sales processes, comprehensive follow-ups, and improvement based on feedback. Deliver budgeted fleet volume and gross margin, ensuring monthly target achievements and budget adherence. Enhance market penetration by introducing initiatives and business opportunities, aiming for growth in market share and customer base expansion. Secure and manage fleet tenders and contracts with UAE Government organizations, fostering revenue growth from these contracts. Participate in fleet product planning, supply chain, and marketing, providing customer feedback and collaborating on marketing plans to maximize revenue. Manage fleet pricing strategies to optimize gross margin and unit sales against budget goals. Required Skills To Be Successful: Advanced stock management and tactical commercial program development skills. Proven abilities in negotiating and closing deals effectively while interpreting and leveraging P&L for used cars. Exceptional training, coaching, and leadership skills to manage and develop sales teams. Highly developed quantitative and analytical skills with computer proficiency for data evaluation and presentation. What Qualifies You For The Role: Strong knowledge of the used car sales and buying process, including F&I systems and methodologies. Substantial experience in Pre-Owned multi-site management within a franchised automotive environment. Proficiency in operating within the B2B sector, with a focus on commercial results and KPI delivery. Arabic speaking ability is preferred, alongside proficiency in English. Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa. With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems. Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey. Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities. Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

results.title: Fleet, Maintenance & Yard Manager
results.description: Lead fleet, workshop maintenance and yard operations to keep the transport fleet safe, compliant and available. Convert operating plans into preventive and corrective maintenance, spare-parts, tyre, fuel and telematics control, and a safe, well-run yard. Govern uptime, cost, safety and asset lifecycle to protect service reliability and margin. Responsibilities Manage in-house workshop and external repair vendors: labor, parts, turnaround time and repair quality. Own spare-parts inventory, tyre management program and warranty claims. Track vehicle downtime, defect rates and repeat-failure root causes; drive corrective actions. Control fuel consumption, card issuance, reconciliation and anti-theft/leakage controls. Manage the GPS/telematics platform: driver behavior, idling, speed and route-compliance monitoring. Ensure compliance with traffic, transport and HSSE regulations; manage permits, inspections and incident reporting. Oversee yard layout, parking, staging, security and traffic flow for trucks and trailers. Coordinate yard safety controls, signage, lighting and housekeeping standards. Manage yard staff scheduling, gate-in/gate-out procedures and in-yard asset tracking. Own the fleet and maintenance operating budget; track cost per km/vehicle and variance to plan. Produce fleet KPI dashboards covering downtime, availability, maintenance cost and safety incidents. Qualifications & Competencies Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/automotive engineering, Logistics or a related field More than 5 years of experience Relevant experience in fleet, workshop or heavy-vehicle maintenance management Knowledge of preventive maintenance systems, fleet management software and telematics platforms Understanding of traffic, transport and HSSE regulatory requirements Vendor and contract management capability Budget planning and cost-control skills Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis and hands-on leadership Effective communication with drivers, workshop teams and cross-functional stakeholders
